basis: Jinshu 53 personal name 王衍.
Xin Tangshu 167 names 炎 as 播's 弟, 擢進士 in 貞元.
notes: Xin Tangshu 167: 播…與弟炎、起皆有名, three brothers who passed 進士. The person is 炎, younger brother of 播, not 王衍. Abbreviated 炎 is identified from that opening; no courtesy-name or kinship chain to Jin 惠風's father.

basis: Jinshu 53: 王衍, father of 惠風.
Jinshu 13: 敦煌太守王延破鮮卑阿妙兒.
notes: Jinshu 13 astronomy treatise: 敦煌太守王延 defeated Xianbei 阿妙兒. Personal name 王延 (given 延) is not 王衍 (given 衍). Cao Wei western command versus Western Jin 太子妃父; no alias chain.

basis: Jinshu 53 personal name 王衍.
Yuanshi 201 personal name 汪琰, husband of 潘氏 of 婺源.
notes: Yuanshi 201 exemplary-women notice: 汪琰妻潘氏 of 徽州婺源; 琰 died when Pan was twenty-eight. Surname 汪 and given 琰 are not 王衍. Yuan household versus Jin 妃父; shared English Wang Yan is romanization only.

basis: Jinshu 53: 妃父王衍.
Xin Tangshu 167: 炎終太常博士 with sons 鐸、鐐.
notes: Xin Tangshu 167 continues 播's brothers: 炎終太常博士, sons 鐸、鐐. Abbreviated 炎 is the Tang brother of 播, not Jin 王衍. Office 太常博士 and Tang lineage do not match 妃父王衍.

basis: Jinshu 53 personal name 王衍.
Nan Qishu 3: 以丹陽尹王晏爲江州刺史; 悉委王晏、徐孝嗣.
notes: Nan Qishu 3 annals: 丹陽尹王晏 made 江州刺史; later 尚書 affairs entrusted to 王晏 and Xu Xiaosi. Southern Qi 王晏, given 晏, is not Western Jin 王衍. English Wang Yan is correct for both graphs separately.

basis: Jinshu 53: 王衍小女惠風.
Nan Qishu 43: 王晏啓世祖曰 about 江斆.
notes: Nan Qishu 43: 王晏啓世祖 about Jiang Xiao's 侍中/驍騎 posting. Same chapter later has 尚書令王晏 at the merit toast. Given 晏 and Qi Wudi/Mingdi court speech; not Jin 王衍 who married 惠風 to the heir.

basis: Jinshu 53 personal name 王衍.
Jiu Wudai Shi 101: 晉州節度使王晏…加同平章事.
notes: Jiu Wudai Shi 101: 晉州節度使王晏 granted 同平章事 with Wu Xingde, Wang Jing, Hou Zhang. Five Dynasties 王晏 is not Jinshu 53 王衍, 惠風's father. Shared romanization Wang Yan is not a merge.

basis: Jinshu 53: 王衍 as 妃父.
Songshi 252: 代王晏為武寧軍節度，與晏兩換其任.
notes: Songshi 252 later biography: 代王晏為武寧軍節度，與晏兩換其任. This 王晏 is the Teng-origin Wuning governor of the same chapter, not Jin 王衍. Given 晏 versus 衍; post-exchange with 武行德 is Five Dynasties–Zhou, not Western Jin.

basis: Jinshu 53 personal name 王衍.
Yuanshi 109: 瀋王王謜，即王璋也, husband of 薊國大長公主.
notes: Yuanshi 109 princess table: 適瀋王王謜，即王璋也. The man is Prince of Shen 王謜, identified as 王璋, Goryeo consort of Budashili. Neither 王謜 nor 王璋 is 王衍. Alternate English Wang Yan on 王謜 is not an identity link to Jin 妃父.

basis: Jinshu 53 personal name 王衍.
Jiu Tangshu 14 personal name 王顏 who 任中丞.
notes: Jiu Tangshu 14: 王顏任中丞日嘗論其事. Personal name 王顏 (given 顏) is not 王衍 (given 衍). Tang Censorate precedent versus Western Jin 太子妃父; no courtesy-name or kinship chain. English Wang Yan correctly spells both different graphs.

basis: Jinshu 053 names 王衍 as father of 惠風 and father-in-law of Crown Prince Minhuai who requested divorce after the prince's deposition.
Jiuwudaishi 077 names 王延, Censor-in-Chief transferred to Right Vice Director of the Secretariat in Tianfu 3 of Later Jin Gaozu.
Primary personal names 王衍 and 王延 are distinct graphs; shared English Wang Yan is only romanization, not an alias chain.
notes: Western Jin aristocratic 王衍 in the Minhuai-prince marriage narrative is not the Later Jin official 王延 of Gaozu's Tianfu court. No courtesy-name or kinship bridge is supplied. Existing 王衍 group membership is left intact.

basis: Jinshu 053's 王衍 is the Western Jin father of Crown Princess 惠風.
Jiuwudaishi 083 names 王延 as Director of Imperial Sacrifices made Minister of Works under Later Jin Emperor Shao (Kaiyun 1).
Different Chinese given names 衍 versus 延; no attested alias linking them.
notes: The Minhuai father-in-law 王衍 cannot be identified with Later Jin 太常卿王延. Shared Wang Yan romanization and official rank are not identity proof. This assignment is not used to merge or split other 王延 records.

basis: Jinshu 053 attests personal name 王衍 in the Crown Prince Minhuai marriage and divorce narrative.
Zizhitongjian 131 Song Records name 上虞令王晏, later abbreviated 晏, who attacked Kuaiji, killed Zhang Sui, and beheaded Kong Kai under Emperor Ming Taishi.
王衍 and 王晏 are different given names; 晏 is not a courtesy alias of 衍 in the supplied units.
notes: Liu Song Shangyu magistrate 王晏 operating in Kuaiji is a different person from Western Jin 王衍, father of 惠風. English Wang Yan correctly romanizes both names and is not a merge key.

basis: Jinshu 053 names 王衍 as 妃父 of the deposed Crown Prince Minhuai.
Jinshu 115 載記 for Fu Pi names 中山太守王兗, later 平東將軍、平州刺史, who held Boling and was killed with 苻鑒 by 慕容驎; the same passage also writes 袞 on the wall.
王兗/袞 is a different personal name from 王衍; in-chapter 兗/袞 variation is not an alias of 衍.
notes: Former Qin Zhongshan administrator 王兗 who died at Boling is not Western Jin 王衍. English Wang Yan for 王兗 is a shared romanization, not a pronunciation error requiring rename. Existing 王衍 group stays whole.
